reason: The submitted CIF is a valid explicit ordered realization: it parses and symmetry-expands in R-3m (No. 166) to Li3V3S6 (12 atoms, Z=3) with unit occupancies and the stated a=b=3.50408 A, c=17.95062 A hexagonal cell; primitive reduction gives one LiVS2 formula unit (4 atoms), so the reported setting/Z introduces no distinct structure. All 19 significant observed lines are indexed by this cell with no important unexplained reflection. More decisively, the instantiated CIF was compared against extracted integrated intensities: refinement gives S z=0.2433687(23), the submitted value, with ordered-model weighted chi-square about 11.6 for 17 degrees of freedom and generally few-percent observed/calculated area agreement. Under the same extraction, a concrete 50/50 Li/V-disordered alternative gives chi-square about 3757, decisively supporting the submitted ordering. The structure has no short contacts; complete shells show six Li-S contacts at 2.5886 A and six V-S contacts at 2.4472 A, formal Li(+1)/V(+3)/S(-2) charge balance, and bond-valence sums consistent with those states (about +0.74, +2.78, and -1.76). No diffraction-supported superstructure, symmetry lowering, occupancy variant, or incompatible framework remains as a concrete viable branch.
